mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM analyses WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'DONE' AND deleted_at IS NULL) AS analysis_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT qq.concept_id FROM quiz_answers qa JOIN quiz_attempts qt ON qt.id = qa.attempt_id JOIN quiz_questions qq ON qq.id = qa.question_id WHERE qt.user_id = #{userId} AND qa.is_correct AND qq.concept_id IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT concept_id FROM review_plans WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'DONE' ) learned) AS learned_concept_count, (SELECT ROUND(100 * SUM(score) / NULLIF(SUM(total), 0)) FROM quiz_attempts WHERE user_id = #{userId}) AS quiz_accuracy
